full_judgment: Plot No. 1228 of Khatian No. 374 of Mouza Patakhali under Shyamnagor police station within Satkhira District, measuring an area of 2.00 acres of land, is government khas land and the petitioner after paying due consideration (salami) procured leasehold interest over the said land from the government in VP Lease Case No. 505/81-82 (Shyam) and brought it under his possession. He has, since then, been cultivating prawn thereon. The respondent No. 9 filed an application to the respondent No.8, praying for lease of the land. The petitioner is always ready to pay the salami for the same for all the years as per rules of the government.
